execution_classification_rules.SELECTION_OBJECTIVE_DENSITY_BLIND_SPOT: PRESENT iff at least 4 folds show selected candidate narrower and higher-EV than frozen runner-up; INSUFFICIENT iff fewer than 3 folds have runner-up evidence.
execution_classification_rules.SELECTIVITY_DENSITY_TRADEOFF: PRESENT iff at least 4 comparable folds show narrower selected subset has higher research EV and lower research n than an exact broader frozen-catalog parent; INSUFFICIENT iff fewer than 3 comparable folds.
execution_classification_rules.SYMBOL_SUBSET_SELECTION_STABILITY: STABLE iff all exact subsets identical; UNSTABLE iff no consecutive exact subset repeats; MIXED otherwise. No fitted numeric threshold.

required_analyses: included vs excluded research cohort quality metrics
density counterfactual if symbol filter removed, diagnostic-only
H10.5 selection objective density blind-spot diagnostic
research_question: Do symbol-specific research selections preserve quality and adequate evidence density when their symbol-selection behavior is evaluated across time, without weakening H10 sample or quality requirements?
